steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each proposal is placed by its appraisal and whether its place in the ranking follows from the criteria.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Proposal with no appraisal
findings.fix: Appraise the proposal before funding is decided

findings.title: Ranking does not follow from the criteria

example:

pros: Checks a proposal with no appraisal, a return figure with no assumption, and a ranking that does not follow from the stated criteria.
cons: Not checked: Strategic fit beyond the criteria.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-fin-capital-allocation-review skill on the records for this review.
